title: Remarks on the positivity of the cotangent bundle of an Enriques surface
summary: Let $S$ be a very general Enriques surface. In this paper we show that $Ω_{S}|_C$ is semistable for a general curve $C \in |H|$, where $H$ is an effective line bundle on $S$. Moreover, we give explicit constructions of families of smooth irreducible curves that destabilize $Ω_S$
